name: slc-central-admin
description: SLC Central Admin — centralized administration platform for the SLC application ecosystem.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @slc/api && npm run build -w @slc/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run build:shared && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
